definitions.explanation: a body type characterized by being thin or lean, as a natural physical constitution

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧やせ{形|がた}だ。
やせ{形|がた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{寒|さむ}さ→寒さ：12336_samusa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じ→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧やすい。
examples.english: People with a thin build tend to feel the cold more in winter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧やせ{形|がた}で、⟦{食|た}べて→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{太|ふと}らない→太る：01190_futoru⟧⟦{体質|たいしつ}→体質：08243_taishitsu⟧だ。
examples.english: My mother has a slender build and a constitution where she doesn't gain weight even when she eats.

notes:
A compound of やせ (thin, from ⟦{痩|や}せる→痩せる：01146_yaseru⟧) and {形|がた} (type, build). Describes a person's natural body constitution rather than a temporary state of thinness.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- やせ{形|がた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a person with a thin build
- やせ{形|がた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体型|たいけい}→体型：16561_taikei⟧: a slender body type

RELATED BODY TYPE TERMS:
- ⟦{太|ふと}り→太る：01190_futoru⟧{形|がた}: heavy-set build, stout body type
- {中肉中背|ちゅうにくちゅうぜい}: average build and height
- ⟦がっしり→がっしり：19940_gasshiri⟧{形|がた}: sturdy, solid build
- ⟦{小柄|こがら}→小柄：12362_kogara⟧: small-framed, petite

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {痩|や}せ{型|がた}: same word written with the kanji for やせ
- ⟦スリム→スリム：21695_surimu⟧: slim — a loanword, often used as a compliment
- ⟦ほっそり→ほっそり：29039_hossori⟧: slender — an adverb/adjective describing a graceful thinness
